summary_ja: エンジニッククリエイティブが人工知能（AI）技術を活用したアニメーション制作でも頭角を現すか期待を集めている。エントニッククリエイティブ（監督チョンチョルヨン）は生成型AIを活用して劇場用長編アニメ予告編を披露した。当該企画案は12年前に資本と人材の限界にぶつかって光を見られなかったが、チョン監督の念願とAI技術で再び姿を現すことができた。専門家だ。ベテラン監督が最近、伝統的な制作方式から抜け出してAI制作方式を導入した部分は、時代的な流れと格別な事業的感覚が相乗効果を出したためと解釈される。
title_en: “New life to the character IP in the drawer”...Entonic creates trailer for animation ‘Findi’ with AI
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Expectations are rising as to whether Entonic Creative will stand out in animation production using artificial intelligence (AI) technology. While the company has made its name known as a content producer for media art exhibitions for government projects and local governments, it has succeeded in breathing new life into animation characters planned 12 years ago with AI technology. According to related industry sources on the 3rd, Entonic Creative (director Cheol-yong Jeong) is using generative AI to produce a full-length animation trailer for theaters. The trailer released this time is the original intellectual property (IP) 'Twinkle', which CEO and director Jeong Cheol-yong conceived in 2014 and planned as a feature-length movie in 2016. The plan did not see the light of day 12 years ago due to limitations in capital and manpower, but was able to reappear thanks to Director Jeong's wishes and AI technology. Director Jeong Cheol-yong is an expert who has operated large-scale 3D CG and video pipelines for about 20 years, including Wemade and Nexon's Game Cinematics and CJ E&M's 'Robot Trains'. The reason why the veteran director recently broke away from the traditional production method and introduced the AI ​​production method is interpreted as the synergy between the trend of the times and his unique business sense. 'Findi' is a film about 'TG...' a village of Mechabug (insects + robots) on the far side of the moon.

summary_en: [GD Net Korea] SK AX has secured a solution from AMDT, an industrial automation and operation technology (OT) management company, to expand its system construction capabilities for U.S. manufacturing companies. According to the industry on the 3rd, SK AX's American subsidiary, SK AX USA, signed a partnership with AMDT early this year and established a system to utilize the company's OT management solution 'Octoplant' for customer projects. If a failure occurs due to a facility error, cyber attack, or program change, the cause can be compared to the previous state and restored to the normal version. title_source: 문화유산, 보존 넘어 '콘텐츠'로…인천연구원 '도시연구' 서평 눈길
summary_source: [지디넷코리아]인천연구원이 발간하는 한국연구재단 등재학술지 '도시연구'에 문화유산을 도시 경쟁력과 콘텐츠산업 관점에서 조명한 서평이 수록됐다.인천연구원은 지난 6월 30일 발간한 '도시연구' 2026년 통권 제29호에 이창근 작가의 'K-헤리티지, 매력 도시 디자인'을 다룬 서평 '유산을 넘어 콘텐츠로: 과거로부터의 선물과 도시의 미래'를 수록했다고 밝혔다.이번 통권 제29호는 종이책 발간을 종료하고 온라인 중심 발행체계로 전환한 첫 번째 호다. 기획주제는 '도시와 산업정책: 전환기 도시경제의 지속가능성 탐색'으로, 관광산업의 지역별 회복력과 도시 상권 및 산업구조 변화 등을 다룬 논문이 함께 실렸다.서평을 집필한 서봉만 인천연구원 선임연구위원은 도서출판 미다스북스가 2026년 펴낸 해당 도서를 다루며, 문화유산을 보존의 대상에 머물지 않고 경험과 콘텐츠, 산업, 도시 브랜드로 활용하는 방안에 주목했다.인천연구원은 이 서평이 향후 문화유산 정책 및 도시 발전전략에 관한 유의미한 시사점을 제시한다고 설명했다.서 연구위원은 대상 도서의 중심 명제를 '보존은 종착점이 아니라 출발점'으로 정의했다. 유산이 데이터와 경험, 산업을 거쳐 다시 보존과 재창조로 돌아오는…
title_ja: 文化遺産、保存を超えて「コンテンツ」で…仁川研究院「都市研究」書評の目
summary_ja: 仁川研究院が発刊する韓国研究財団登載学術誌「都市研究」に文化遺産を都市競争力とコンテンツ産業の観点から照明した書評が収録された。取り上げた書評「遺産を越えてコンテンツとして：過去からのプレゼントと都市の未来」を収録したと明らかにした。企画主題は「都市と産業政策：転換期都市経済の持続可能性探索」で、観光産業の地域別回復力と都市商圏及び産業構造変化などを扱った論文が一緒に載せられた。書評を執筆した西峰湾仁川研究院先任研究委員は滞在しないで経験とコンテンツ、産業、都市ブランドとして活用する方案に注目した。仁川研究院はこの書評が今後文化遺産政策及び都市発展戦略に関する有意な示唆点を提示すると説明した。遺産がデータと経験、産業を経て再び保存と再創造に戻る…
title_en: Cultural heritage goes beyond preservation to ‘content’… Incheon Research Institute's 'Urban Research' book review
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] A book review that highlights cultural heritage from the perspective of urban competitiveness and the content industry was included in 'Urban Research', an academic journal registered with the National Research Foundation of Korea published by the Incheon Research Institute. In the 2026 volume 29 of 'Urban Research' published on June 30, the Incheon Research Institute included a book review on author Lee Chang-geun's 'K-Heritage, Attractive Urban Design', 'Beyond Heritage to Content: From the Past'. It was announced that it included 'Gifts and the Future of the City'. This volume, No. 29, is the first issue that ended publishing paper books and switched to an online-based publishing system. The theme of the project was 'Urban and Industrial Policy: Exploring the Sustainability of the Urban Economy in Transition', and papers were published on regional resilience of the tourism industry and changes in urban commercial districts and industrial structures. Seo Bong-man, a senior researcher at the Incheon Research Institute who wrote the book review, dealt with the book published in 2026 by the book publisher Midas Books and focused on ways to use cultural heritage as an experience, content, industry, and city brand rather than just an object of preservation. The Incheon Research Institute It was explained that the book review presents meaningful implications for future cultural heritage policies and urban development strategies. The researcher defined the central proposition of the target book as 'preservation is not an end point, but a starting point.' Heritage passes through data, experience, and industry and returns to preservation and re-creation...

title_en: Ubisoft, Web3 NFT strategy ‘Champions Tactics’ service to end in October
summary_en: [ZD Net Korea] Ubisoft is terminating the service of the web3-based non-fungible token (NFT) strategy game 'Champions Tactics: Grimoria Chronicles (hereinafter referred to as Champions Tactics).' According to foreign media such as Engadget on the 31st (local time) last month, Ubisoft said, "After careful review, we have decided to end the game service," and "the server is scheduled to officially end on October 30." This game features combat units. It is a Web 3-based strategy game that emphasizes minting (issuance) in the blockchain marketplace and trading with cryptocurrency as its core competitiveness. Foreign media paid attention to the timing of the game's release along with Ubisoft's decision to terminate the service. The global NFT craze peaked in 2021 and then began to decline starting in 2022. However, Champions Tactics was released two years later, in 2024. It is pointed out that the new game was introduced when the trend had already passed. Afterwards, Ubisoft attempted to change the operating method by sequentially removing the Web 3 function in the game in May, but ultimately decided to terminate the service two years after launch. Meanwhile, foreign media reported that Ubisoft is encouraging existing users to play the new TCG 'Might and Magic Fates'. Ubisoft is promoting in-game compensation benefits to attract users…
